facts.business: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited is an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company engaged in project execution across sectors such as power, steel, mining, and material handling, and also has interests in joint ventures for project execution.

auditor.name: V. Singhi & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-compliance with Regulation 17 of SEBI LODR regarding Board composition until 22nd October 2025 and delay in submission of financial results under Regulation 33 for quarter and year ended 31st December 2025, submitted on 20th February 2026 after due date of 14th February 2025.

key_risks: Company was under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) from April 2022 until implementation of resolution plan in January 2025
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations leading to SOP fines from stock exchanges
Trade receivables, payables, and advances subject to confirmation, reconciliation, and pending arbitrations
EPFO demand of Rs 564.81 Lakhs damages and Rs 395.52 Lakhs interest under challenge in courts
Going concern dependent on successful implementation of resolution plan and realization of assets
facts.related_party_note: Joint ventures include EMC MBE Contracting Co LLC (35% in Oman), McNally-AML (98% in Dipka, 97% in Ananta), McNally-Trolex (96% in Chhal, 97% in Baroud), McNally-Trolex-Kilburn (80% in Sardega).
